audit.whatIsWrong: Three rows render two different answers: whys[0], whys[2] and whys[4] all say 'favours you' while win[0], win[2] and win[4] say Swain. Swain also held 5 of 7 stages at 2/10 against a 53.72% Warwick win rate.
audit.why: Warwick's stages are level 3 (full pattern versus a 12s Nevermove) and level 6; Swain's are 4-5 and first item, when the root lands reliably and the drain scales. Level 1 and the two-item stage are even.
audit.corrected: Skill, Skill, Warwick, Swain, Warwick, Swain, Skill — paired across both layers, ratings 5/5/6/3/6/3/5, matching the rows the swain__warwick mirror already set.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike said only to ult 'early in a trade, not late', with no item answer.
audit.why: Demonic Ascension drains from every nearby champion, minion and monster on a 120s cooldown — the counter is healing reduction, not timing alone. Infinite Duress is 1.5s of suppression on a 110s rank-1 cooldown, so it has to be spent where the drain is cut.
audit.corrected: Spike now pairs the ult window with Grievous Wounds from Executioner's Calling.
sources: Swain kit R text and cd 120

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] says that once Nevermove's pull connects 'he burst-heals off you'.
audit.why: Nevermove roots and pulls; it does not heal. Swain's healing comes from Ravenous Flock's Soul Fragments and from Demonic Ascension's drain. The page attributed a heal to the wrong ability.
audit.corrected: Spike rewritten to the pull-and-root with Nevermove's real 12s rank-1 cooldown as the commit window.
sources: Swain kit E text and cd 12/11.5/11/10.5/10

audit.whatIsWrong: diff says FAV while diffRating says 8.5/10 and report[14] calls it a hard matchup.
audit.why: Contradictory labels on a lane Warwick wins 53.72%.
audit.corrected: FAV kept, rating set to 6/10 with the two prose lines that quote the number updated in the same pass, and tone moved to the even/favoured colour.

edits.before: Level 1 favours you: Warwick's Q ticks out-trade Swain's slow early poke before he has E.
edits.after: Level 1 is even: Eternal Hunger out-sustains chip, but Death's Hand pokes from 750 range.

edits.before: 2+ items favour Swain: unkillable AoE drain-tank who zones you out of every fight.
edits.after: 2+ items are even: he drain-tanks fights, but Grievous Wounds cuts it back.

edits.before: W Blood Hunt speed lets you dodge his W Vision of Empire zone and close before he lands E Nevermove root — but the moment his E pull connects he burst-heals off you, so bait it first.
edits.after: Blood Hunt speed lets you dodge his Vision of Empire (W) zone and close before Nevermove (E) roots you — E is 12s at rank 1, so bait the pull, then commit inside that window.

edits.before: R Infinite Duress locks Swain in place, yet his R Demonic Ascension sustain and Q barrage can out-heal your burst if he's already ramped — ult him early in a trade, not late.
edits.after: Ult before Demonic Ascension is running, not after: his R drains every nearby unit, so Grievous Wounds from Executioner's Calling is what makes your 1.5s suppress lethal.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 8.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Demonic Ascension and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 6/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Demonic Ascension and how disciplined your pattern is.

edits.before: Hard matchup — difficulty 8.5/10, Swain carry threat 8/10.
edits.after: Even matchup — difficulty 6/10, Swain carry threat 8/10.

notes: Not asserted: whether Swain can keep draining while suppressed by Infinite Duress, and whether Nevermove's root cancels the channel. Neither is in Riot's text and the mirror dropped the same claim for the same reason. Chart aligned to the rows the swain__warwick mirror explicitly set (row 0 Skill, rows 3 and 5 Swain, row 6 Skill) with the remaining rows taken from the packet chart and the existing why-lines.
